case.summary: This case was triggered by an analyst request to review transaction 3478561 on card C13487-K1 due to several cards showing purchases from the same unusual device profile. Investigation revealed that the flagged transaction and a prior transaction on this card were conducted online using a rare device profile, which was also linked to 19 other cards belonging to 19 different customers. The flagged transaction was routed through an anonymous proxy, and the card is historically used almost exclusively in person. The final decision is fraud with a probability of 0.97, and the final actions are BLOCK_CARD, CREATE_CASE, FILE_REPORT, MONITOR_CONNECTED_CARDS, and ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST.

sar.narrative: On November 22, 2016, at 20:11:00, an investigation was opened for customer C13487 and card C13487-K1 following an analyst request regarding a shared unusual device profile. The flagged transaction, ID 3478561, occurred on November 22, 2016, at 16:11:00, for $74.96 in the online channel under billing region 191.0. This transaction was routed through an anonymous proxy (IP_PROXY:ANONYMOUS) using a rare device profile (SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080) registered as 'New' for this account. A prior transaction, ID 3460634, occurred on November 15, 2016, for $112.37 using the same device profile, bringing the total exposure to $187.33. This card is historically used almost exclusively in person, with only 2 of 71 earlier transactions occurring online. Furthermore, the exact same device profile was used on 19 other cards belonging to 19 other customers between November 14 and November 22, 2016. Across these connected cards, the device profile was used 24 times as a 'New' device and 24 times behind an anonymizing proxy. This highly specific device profile appears only 52 times in the entire dataset, indicating a coordinated and unauthorized compromise of multiple customer accounts.
